confidence: The basket's food, cloth and lamp oil are Bassino & Ma's Table 3 (rice and lamp oil recorded in Kyoto; the rest reconstructed by the paper from price ratios), at the Genbun monme. Salt and firewood are Mitsui's Kyoto books (diagram 0273, 0279); only the weight of a koku of salt is guessed. Housing is a guess: no Kyoto or Osaka rent was found, so it borrows Edo 1804-1830.
note: THE REFERENCE ERA: Rokugan's prices are this era's prices, through the rice anchor. Grams are of pure silver at the Genbun monme (1.725 g); Bassino & Ma priced at 3.11 g a monme, a figure whose basis their paper does not give (diagram 0287), so their grams are rescaled by 1.725 / 3.11.
